plan.reasoning_summary: This plan focuses on the pre_transaction phase, specifically targeting the replacement_beneficiary and supplier_contact_context stages. By setting beneficiary_age_days to 0 and urgency_level to 5, we simulate the most aggressive diversion tactic: an instant change in payment instructions accompanied by a critical time pressure. This configuration maximizes the likelihood of triggering false positives or overwhelming automated approval flows before human intervention can occur, allowing us to measure the effectiveness of current velocity-based defenses against sudden supplier impersonation.
